content.text: (Sending a picture) Sigh, Xingchen, look at my match record—five losses in a row, I’m about to lose my mind! My teammates either go AFK or feed like crazy. The matchmaking system is just too unfair.
Haha, Xiaomeng, your record is really rough! Don't be upset—it's just a game, and wins and losses are part of it. I understand how you feel; losing streaks can be really frustrating.
Exactly, I'm already busy enough with work. I finally managed to squeeze in a few games, and this happens. It feels so unfair. How about you? You probably didn't have it as bad as I did, right?
I've been doing okay lately, occasionally messing up, but overall I'm holding steady. How about I carry you for a few rounds? I guarantee you'll get to experience the joy of victory!
Really? Don't fool me. I'm not very skilled, so I don't want to hold you back.
(Sending a picture) Look, this is my hero's combat power. Pretty strong, right? I've got the skills to back it up—no problem carrying you to victory!
Wow, so many high-power heroes! I'm in awe of the master! How did you train to become so skilled?

Haha, you're too kind! I work part-time as a game streamer, so I often watch live streams and guides to learn some strategies and techniques. Things like positioning and game sense—I’ve gradually improved over time.
I see, no wonder you react so quickly. I usually just play casually without much research. Do you have any suggestions? For example, which heroes should I play?
(Sending a picture) Take a look at this—the mid-lane hero tier list. I suggest you try the T0 or T1 heroes. They’re easy to play, strong, and beginner-friendly.
Thanks for sharing! This ranking list is really practical, I'll give it a try later. However, I'm still feeling a bit down right now, so I might not play well.
Don't overthink it. Games are all about having fun. How about we team up and play a few rounds right now? I'll carry you, guaranteed to make you laugh out loud!
Xingchen, you're so kind and enthusiastic. But I'm really not in the mood today. The consecutive losses have hit me too hard, and I just need some time to recover.
I understand, playing games when you're in a bad mood can indeed make things worse. How about we plan to meet when you're feeling better? I'm free anytime!
Well, okay! Thank you for comforting me and giving me so much advice. Next time, I'll definitely cheer up and play with you.
No problem! Remember, fun comes first—don't let the game affect your mood. Whenever you're ready, just call me, and we'll climb the ranks together!
Alright, it's a deal! I'll go attend to my work first and adjust my mindset. I'll get in touch with you later.
Alright, then I'll let you get back to your work. Stay in touch, and I look forward to teaming up again next time!
